title: Council wax seal
subject: a single round blob of deep crimson sealing wax, poured and pressed flat, its rim thick and irregular where the molten wax spread and cooled in soft lobes, the middle pressed down by a brass seal matrix leaving a sunken round impression of a simple royal crown with three points, the wax semi-matte with a faint waxy sheen on the raised rim, small air pits and a slight darker edge, about seven centimetres across, nothing written anywhere
